description: Find public EV charging stations in Lithuania near a point (lat/lng) or in a city, with current prices in EUR/kWh incl. VAT, max power in kW, connector types and live free charge points. With `near` results are sorted by distance; otherwise cheapest first (in `power_class` when given). Each station has a `source_url` to cite. Coverage: Lithuania only.

available_only.description: Only stations with at least one charge point reported free right now.

city.description: City or town in Lithuania, e.g. "Vilnius", "Kaunas", "Klaipėda". Inflected forms like "Kaune" work too.

max_price_eur_kwh.description: Maximum price, EUR per kWh incl. VAT (in `power_class` when given).

near.description: Search around this point. Use instead of `city` when you know coordinates.

operator.description: Charging network name or slug, e.g. "Ignitis ON", "Eldrive".

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more. Only stations with a price in this class are returned.

standard.description: Connector standard the station must have.

name: find_stations
title: Find EV charging stations in Lithuania
